readme:
# iBOT：中心化教师与掩码 Patch 蒸馏

## 1. 问题

[iBOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07832) 将图像级自蒸馏与在线教师的遮挡 patch 预测结合。其 patch 目标是学习到的 prototype 上的概率分布，而非固定 tokenizer ID。本题从给定 logits 出发，只实现**同一全局视图、单 crop 的 patch 分支**。

实现 `teacher_patch_targets(teacher_logits, center, teacher_temp=.04)` 和 `ibot_patch_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, mask, center, student_temp=.1, teacher_temp=.04)`。学生与教师 logits 为 `[B,N,K]`，center 为 `[K]`，Boolean mask `[B,N]` 选择被监督的学生 patch。两个函数分别返回停止梯度的 `[B,N,K]` 教师概率与标量损失。

## 2. 核心公式

先对教师 prototype 分数做中心化，再除温度进行 softmax，停止整个教师分支的梯度：

$$
q_{bnk}=\operatorname{sg}\!\left[\operatorname{softmax}_k\left(\frac{t_{bnk}-c_k}{\tau_t}\right)\right],\qquad
\log p_{bnk}=\operatorname{logsoftmax}_k\left(\frac{s_{bnk}}{\tau_s}\right).
$$

[官方 `iBOTLoss.forward`](https://github.com/bytedance/ibot/blob/main/main_ibot.py) 先计算**每张图内部的遮挡均值**，然后平均所有图像。记 $M_b=\sum_n m_{bn}$：

$$
\ell_{bn}=-\sum_k q_{bnk}\log p_{bnk},\qquad
\mathcal L=\frac1B\sum_b\frac{\sum_n m_{bn}\ell_{bn}}{\max(M_b,1)}.
$$

没有遮挡 patch 的图贡献零，但仍计入 `B`。选中学生分数的梯度是 $(p_{bnk}-q_{bnk})/(B M_b\tau_s)$。教师 logits 与 center 不求梯度。当 `p=q` 时损失等于教师熵，通常为正；软教师的最优交叉熵并不是零。

## 3. 公式到代码

1. 减去 `[K]` center，除以教师温度，沿最后一轴 softmax，detach 整个目标。
2. 学生 logits 除以学生温度，沿最后一轴计算稳定 log-softmax。
3. 乘教师概率，沿 prototype 轴求和并取负。
4. 应用 patch mask；每张图的和除以至少为一的遮挡数量，再对所有图求均值。

调用本文件的 helper，保留输入校验。不要将软教师换成 argmax 标签、打乱图像对应关系，或对所有遮挡 patch 做全局均值。CLS 分支的跨视图配对不适用于这个 patch 分支。

## 4. 本题约定

- 学生/教师为形状一致且非空的 `[B,N,K]`，center 为 `[K]`，均为有限、同 dtype/device 的 float32/float64。mask 为同设备 Boolean `[B,N]`。不修改输入，保持 dtype/device，支持非连续视图。
- 两个温度均为有限正 Python int/float，拒绝 bool 与 Tensor 标量。默认值对应官方名义温度；本题不实现温度调度。
- 教师目标连同 center 一起停止梯度。可见学生 patch 梯度为零；全空 mask 返回可微零。`K=1` 时目标概率为一，交叉熵为零。
- 调用期间 center 是固定输入。本题不实现 center EMA、教师 EMA、多 crop 均值、共享投影头结构或图像级 CLS 目标。`[K]` 是官方 `[1,1,K]` 广播 center 的简化接口。
- 各 patch 的学生/教师 logits 可分别加常数而不改变概率。教师与 center 同时加同一 prototype 向量也不改变目标。

测试覆盖独立标量概率与 CE、学生解析及有限差分梯度、教师/center 停梯度、不等及空 mask 行、一致置换、软目标熵、单类别词表与极端分数。

## 5. 交互图与 CPU 实验

Lab 直接优化一个 **`3×4×4` 学生 logit 表**，拟合确定性的固定教师 logits 与 center。三张图分别选中 `1,3,0` 个 patch。Adam 以 `.08` 进行 **120 次真实更新**；学生/教师温度取 `.7/.5`，便于观察软分布。教师与 center 故意加入 optimizer 检查梯度边界，正确实现应使它们保持不变。

图表展示提交 CE、教师熵下界、独立计算的图像均衡 KL，以及一个遮挡 patch 的教师/学生概率。参考 CPU 的 KL 从约 `.10581` 降到 `1.8e-7`；CE 接近 `.81916`，而非零。T3 要求 KL 小于 `1e-5` 且小于初值的 `.001`，与 oracle 差异小于 `1e-12`，教师、center 和可见学生 logits 漂移均为零。该有界合成蒸馏实验不训练编码器、不更新在线 tokenizer，也不复现 iBOT 基准结果。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸阅读

对照 iBOT 第 3 节与官方 `iBOTLoss` 的两个分支。为什么 patch 匹配采用同一全局视图，而 class token 使用跨视图项？教师中心化与温度分别起什么作用？为什么教师权重与 center 必须在这个目标的梯度下降之外更新？

比较 [BEiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.08254) 的硬 token 目标和 [DINO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.14294) 的图像级自蒸馏。推导图像均衡的遮挡均值何时等于全局遮挡 token 均值、何时不同。
notes:
# iBOT 实现坑点

本题对齐官方 `iBOTLoss.forward` 中同视图的 patch 项。完整目标还有跨视图图像级 CLS 自蒸馏与相应 crop 项的平均；训练系统还以移动平均更新教师权重及 center。这些状态更新没有隐藏在本题损失内。固定 `[K]` center 只是官方 patch center 广播形状的简化。

教师中心化在温度 softmax 之前减去各 prototype 的偏置。要 detach 最终概率分布，不能只 detach logits 后再减一个可微 center；梯度边界同时覆盖两者。学生温度还产生 `1/student_temp` 的链式导数。软目标保留不确定性：学生匹配教师后，CE 等于熵，KL 等于零。

| 错误 | 独立检验证据 |
| --- | --- |
| 缺少 center | 非常量 prototype 偏置改变独立计算的目标概率。 |
| 忽略教师温度 | 测试同时覆盖较尖锐默认温度与较软显式温度。 |
| 教师或 center 梯度泄漏 | 目标须停止梯度、损失无对应导数，训练中两者不移动。 |
| 忽略学生温度 | 学生解析梯度显式包含其链式缩放。 |
| 全局遮挡均值 | `1,2,0` 个遮挡 patch 的图像区分官方图像均衡归约。 |
| 纳入可见 patch | 改变其分数不影响损失，可见学生参数不能移动。 |
| 图像对应错误 | 不对称教师示例揭示跨图像目标错配。 |
| 教师硬标签化 | 软概率、熵下界以及匹配分布时的零梯度排除 argmax。 |
| 非连续学生梯度丢失 | 交错父存储 VJP 保留每个 prototype 的导数，同时教师/center 父张量停梯度、未使用存储为零。 |

空 mask 行贡献零，但仍计入 batch 分母，与官方图内 clamp 公式一致。单 prototype 与极端分数测试分别覆盖边界和数值稳定性。中心差分使用独立标量 softmax/CE，只扰动学生，因为教师目标按定义停止梯度。

T3 使用 48 个学生 logits、`1,3,0` 个遮挡位置、`.08` 学习率的 120 次 Adam 更新及 `.7/.5` 温度。PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU float64 实测 KL `.10580984 → 1.80e-7`，CE `.81916371`，教师熵 `.81916353`。验收要求 KL 小于 `1e-5` 且小于初值的 `.001`，并检查教师、center、可见学生漂移均为零。公共 fixture 固定 seed 42 与两条线程；实验初值为确定性正弦函数。固定教师 logit 拟合只演示这个目标，不代表有用表示的涌现或在线 tokenizer 训练。

en.title: iBOT Centered Teacher and Masked Patch Distillation
en.readme:
# iBOT: centered teacher and masked patch distillation

## 1. Problem

[iBOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07832) combines image-level self-distillation with masked patch prediction from an online teacher. Its patch targets are distributions over learned prototypes, rather than fixed tokenizer IDs. This exercise isolates the **same-view, single-global-crop patch branch** on supplied logits.

Implement `teacher_patch_targets(teacher_logits, center, teacher_temp=.04)` and `ibot_patch_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, mask, center, student_temp=.1, teacher_temp=.04)`. Student and teacher logits are `[B,N,K]`, the center is `[K]`, and Boolean mask `[B,N]` selects student patches to supervise. Return detached `[B,N,K]` teacher probabilities and one scalar loss.

## 2. Core equations

Center the teacher's prototype scores before temperature-softmax, and stop the complete teacher branch:

$$
q_{bnk}=\operatorname{sg}\!\left[\operatorname{softmax}_k\left(\frac{t_{bnk}-c_k}{\tau_t}\right)\right],\qquad
\log p_{bnk}=\operatorname{logsoftmax}_k\left(\frac{s_{bnk}}{\tau_s}\right).
$$

The [official `iBOTLoss.forward`](https://github.com/bytedance/ibot/blob/main/main_ibot.py) computes a masked mean **within each image**, then averages all images. With $M_b=\sum_n m_{bn}$:

$$
\ell_{bn}=-\sum_k q_{bnk}\log p_{bnk},\qquad
\mathcal L=\frac1B\sum_b\frac{\sum_n m_{bn}\ell_{bn}}{\max(M_b,1)}.
$$

An image with zero masked patches contributes zero and still counts in `B`. For a selected student score, the gradient is $(p_{bnk}-q_{bnk})/(B M_b\tau_s)$. Teacher logits and center have no gradient. Matching `p=q` yields teacher entropy, generally a positive value; zero cross entropy is not the target for a soft teacher.

## 3. From equations to code

1. Subtract the `[K]` center, divide by teacher temperature, apply final-axis softmax and detach the entire target.
2. Divide student logits by student temperature and use stable final-axis log-softmax.
3. Multiply by teacher probabilities, sum over prototypes and negate.
4. Mask the patch losses. Divide each image's sum by its masked count clamped to one, then average all images.

Use the helper in this file; keep supplied validation. Do not replace teacher probabilities with argmax labels, swap image correspondence or average over all masked patches globally. The CLS branch's cross-view pairing is not the pairing of this patch branch.

## 4. Exercise conventions

- Matched nonempty `[B,N,K]` student/teacher tensors and `[K]` center share float32/float64 dtype, device and finite values. Mask is Boolean `[B,N]` on the same device. Preserve inputs, dtype/device and support strided views.
- Both temperatures are finite positive Python int/float; reject bool and Tensor scalars. Defaults follow the nominal official temperatures; no temperature schedule is applied here.
- The teacher target, including the center, is stopped. Visible student patches receive zero gradients; empty whole masks return differentiable zero. `K=1` has target probability one and zero CE.
- The center is supplied and fixed during this call. Center EMA, teacher EMA, multi-crop averaging, shared projection-head architecture and the image-level CLS objective remain outside this module. `[K]` simplifies the official broadcast center shape `[1,1,K]`.
- Student score offsets and teacher score offsets may vary per patch without changing probabilities. Adding the same prototype vector to teacher logits and center also preserves targets.

Tests use independent scalar probabilities and CE, exact and finite-difference student gradients, stopped teacher/center checks, unequal and empty mask rows, consistent permutations, soft-target entropy, singleton vocabulary and extreme scores.

## 5. Interactive charts and CPU experiment

The Lab directly optimizes a **`3×4×4` student logit table** against fixed deterministic teacher logits and a center. Images contain `1,3,0` selected patches. Adam performs **120 actual updates at `.08`**, with student/teacher temperatures `.7/.5` to make the soft distributions easy to inspect. Teacher and center are included in the optimizer as a gradient-boundary check; they must remain fixed.

Charts show your CE alongside the teacher entropy floor, independently computed image-balanced KL, and teacher/student probabilities for one masked patch. Reference CPU KL decreases from about `.10581` to `1.8e-7`; CE approaches `.81916`, not zero. T3 requires KL below `1e-5` and `.001` of baseline, oracle agreement within `1e-12`, and zero drift in teacher, center and visible student logits. This bounded synthetic distillation task does not train an encoder, update an online tokenizer or reproduce iBOT benchmark results.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further reading

Read iBOT Section 3 and both branches of the official `iBOTLoss`. Why does patch matching use the same global view while the class-token objective uses cross-view terms? What distinct roles do teacher centering and temperature play? Why must teacher weights and center be updated outside gradient descent on this objective?

Compare [BEiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.08254) hard token targets and [DINO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.14294) image-level self-distillation. Derive when image-balanced masked means equal the global masked-token mean and when they differ.
en.notes:
# iBOT implementation notes

This module follows the same-view patch component of official `iBOTLoss.forward`. The complete objective additionally uses image-level cross-view CLS self-distillation and averages appropriate crop terms. The full training system updates teacher weights and centers by moving averages; those state transitions are intentionally not hidden inside this loss. The fixed `[K]` center is a simplified broadcast shape for the official patch center.

Teacher centering subtracts prototype-specific biases before temperature-softmax. Detach the resulting distribution, not merely the logits before subtracting a live center. The gradient boundary covers both teacher and center. Student temperature contributes a `1/student_temp` chain-rule factor. Soft teacher targets retain uncertainty: when the student matches them, CE equals entropy and KL is zero.

| Fault | Independent evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Missing center | Nonconstant prototype offsets change the independently computed target probabilities. |
| Missing teacher temperature | Tests exercise sharp default and softer explicit temperatures. |
| Teacher or center gradient leak | Target tensors must be stopped, loss gradients absent, and both tables fixed during optimization. |
| Missing student temperature | Exact student gradients include its chain-rule factor. |
| Global masked mean | Images with `1,2,0` selected patches distinguish the official image-balanced reduction. |
| Including visible patches | Their score changes cannot affect loss; their student parameters must never move. |
| Wrong image correspondence | Asymmetric teacher examples expose cross-image target pairing. |
| Hard teacher labels | Scalar soft targets, entropy-floor values and zero gradient at distribution matching rule out argmax. |
| Strided student gradient loss | Interleaved parent VJPs preserve all prototype derivatives while teacher/center parents remain stopped and unused storage stays zero. |

Empty mask rows contribute zero and remain in the batch denominator, exactly as the released clamped per-image formula specifies. The single-prototype and large-score tests separately exercise endpoints and numerical stability. Central differences use independent scalar softmax/CE arithmetic; only the student is perturbed because teacher targets are defined as stopped.

T3 uses 48 student logits with mask counts `1,3,0`, 120 Adam updates at `.08`, and temperatures `.7/.5`. PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU float64 measured KL `.10580984 → 1.80e-7`, CE `.81916371` and teacher entropy `.81916353`. Acceptance requires KL below `1e-5` and `.001` of its baseline, plus zero teacher/center/visible drift. The common fixture uses seed 42 and two threads; the experiment has deterministic sinusoidal initial conditions. Fixed-teacher logit fitting demonstrates only this objective, not emergence of useful representations or online-tokenizer training.
